title: &aThe Quartermaster's Ledger
subtitle: Chests that grow, sort themselves and answer to one desk.

quests.title: A Proper Chest
quests.subtitle: Sophisticated Storage
desc: Every hero ends up with a cellar full of loot. Let's make it a good one.

A &eSophisticated chest&r or &ebarrel&r starts like any chest: 27 slots. But it takes &eupgrades&r, it can be &eraised a tier without emptying it&r, and when you break it, it &ekeeps everything inside&r: it drops as one packed chest, like a shulker box. No more emptying a room to move it.
Make either one (JEI shows the recipe). You can recolour and re-texture them later at a &eDecoration Table&r.

quests.title: Bands of Copper and Iron
desc: Right-click a placed storage with a &etier upgrade&r and it grows on the spot, contents and all.
&6Copper&r 45 slots · &7Iron&r 54 slots and 2 upgrade slots · &eGold&r 81 and 3 · &bDiamond&r 108 and 4 · &8Netherite&r 132 and 5.
Make a &eBasic to Copper&r or &eBasic to Iron&r tier upgrade.

quests.title: The Upgrade Base
desc: Almost every upgrade starts as an &eUpgrade Base&r: planks and iron. Upgrades go in the slots on the side of the storage's window.
Wood and copper storage have &e1&r upgrade slot; every tier after that adds one.
&7(The same idea as your backpack's upgrades. Backpack and storage upgrades are different items, though: JEI shows which is which.)

quests.title: Stack It High
desc: A &eStack Upgrade&r lets every slot hold more than a normal stack. Higher tiers multiply more, all the way to the endgame &eOmega&r tier.
A barrel with two Stack Upgrades swallows a whole mining trip.

quests.title: Compact the Rubble
desc: Two upgrades for miners:
&eCompacting&r turns 9 nuggets into an ingot and 9 ingots into a block, all by itself.
&eVoid&r deletes what you tell it to: cobblestone, dirt, netherrack. Perfect next to vein mining.
Make either one.

quests.title: Hands-Free
desc: Storage that works while you're away:
&eMagnet&r pulls in loose items nearby (3 blocks; 5 for the advanced one).
&eHopper&r moves items in and out like a hopper.
&eSmelting&r turns the storage into a furnace that never runs out of room.
They're tuned light, so even a big base won't lag. Make any one.

quests.title: The Quartermaster's Desk
desc: A &eStorage Controller&r turns a room of chests into one store.

Place it touching your storage. Every storage that touches it, or touches one that does, joins its network, as long as it's within &e15 blocks&r. Open the controller to see and search everything at once; whatever you put in goes where it fits best.
&7(It works with your sorting: an item goes first to a storage that already holds it.)

quests.title: Long Reach
desc: Storage that doesn't touch the rest can still join: a &eStorage Link&r connects whatever it touches to a controller in range.
&eStorage Input&r, &eOutput&r and &eI/O&r blocks open the whole network to hoppers, Create funnels and pipes. Feed your farm straight into the vault.

quests.title: One Thing per Drawer
desc: &eLimited barrels&r hold one kind of item per section and show it on the front, with the count. They're drawers for a tidy base: one, two, three or four sections.
Make any limited barrel.

quests.title: Gold and Diamond
desc: Raise your storage to &eGold&r (81 slots, 3 upgrade slots) or &bDiamond&r (108 slots, 4 upgrade slots).
Make an &eIron to Gold&r or &eGold to Diamond&r tier upgrade.

quests.title: Pack It Up
desc: Sophisticated &eshulker boxes&r take upgrades and tiers too, and you can carry them full. They just can't hold other shulker boxes.
You'll need shulker shells from the End.

quests.title: The Netherite Vault
desc: The last tier: &8Netherite&r storage, with 132 slots and 5 upgrade slots. Add Stack Upgrades and one chest holds a kingdom's treasury.
Make a &eDiamond to Netherite&r tier upgrade.
